scenes.sub: Assalamu alaikum. Who is teaching your child the Quran?

chips: Head of Academics is a Hafiza
scenes.sub: Every teacher passes a recitation test before teaching, and our Head of Academics is a Hafiza.
Every teacher also accepts our Code of Conduct before teaching.
Teachers never record a class or share a child's image, and never contact families privately.
Every class takes place inside the academy's own online classroom.
Prefer a female teacher? Just ask when you book.
Book a free trial class at nurulhudaacademy.org
